new_in_run17.orient_retry: ENGAGED LIVE and delivered its design goal (orient_kb_attempts=3): the first two ORIENT KB searches timed out against the CPU-pegged daemon and were RETRIED with backoff (5/15s) instead of being conceded as 'no stored program'; the third attempt recalled and adopted the run-15 dev-repaired program whole (native /note/get path, revalidation 4/4 probes). synthesis_attempts=0 — the needless ~15-minute SYNTHESIZE cycle that opened run 16 was fully removed. Mechanism: KbClient.last_search_failed distinguishes a retryable timeout from a genuine empty result; search_for_mode ORIENT short-circuits on the flag instead of running the hypothesis-menu search (which would have cleared it); config orient_retries=3, backoff (5,15,30)s.
new_in_run17.llm_free_exploration_executor: landed in code (config.exploration_executor, max_frontier_batches_per_turn=8): once trusted, exploration loops CPU-plan -> execute frontier batch -> CPU-plan next batch with ZERO decide calls; the LLM re-enters only on expect-mismatch or frontier exhaustion, reflect stays log-only on the fast path. Engaged live but could not SUSTAIN: 3 live divergences dropped trust early each time, so only 2 frontier batches ran before control returned to REPAIR.

why_no_level_cleared: NO level cleared (levels_completed=0, won=false, stop_reason=budget). The ORIENT retry removed the synthesis-cycle waste completely (synthesis_attempts 1 -> 0; orient adopted on attempt 3 of the retry loop), but the reclaimed budget was consumed by a NEW dominant cost: 3 live divergences each routed to REPAIR (6 repair decide attempts, all failed extract/compile — qwen-coding again emitted prose/non-compiling blocks under the repair prompt), and each repair decide takes minutes on the loaded 35B model. Because every divergence drops fast-path trust, the LLM-free exploration executor engaged but never SUSTAINED: 2 frontier batches, 0 fast-path batches, 3 reflect skips. llm_calls_per_action stayed 2.0 per recorded transition (18 calls / 9 transitions; 0.9 per session action) instead of the <0.2 target. The level boundary was again never observed, so is_win was never re-derived and planning stayed goal-blind. The bottleneck has MOVED: from ORIENT-concession (fixed) to the REPAIR loop — 6 minutes-long repair decides that have failed extract/compile in 3 consecutive runs (18/18 candidates). Next lever: stop re-entering REPAIR on transient divergences when the recalled program's live pass-rate stays at 1.0 (all 3 divergences were transient — the suite-scored live window ended at 1.0), or cap repair decides per run for a known-good recalled model.
